lines.japanese: ああうるさい。
lines.english: Oh, shut up.

lines.japanese: 朝から騒音をたてて安眠妨害も甚だしい。ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ。
lines.english: All that noise first thing in the morning—an outrageous assault on peaceful sleep. I'll fucking kill you, asshole.

lines.japanese: 誰だか知らないが俺の眠りを妨げたやつがいる。選挙カーやパトカーなら八つ当たり先もまだあるが、この怒りをどこにぶつければいいのか分からない。
lines.english: Some unknown party had disturbed my sleep. An election van or a police car would at least have given me somewhere to direct the blame. As it was, I had no idea where to vent this rage.

lines.japanese: 俺は階段を下りて勢いよく襖を開いた。
lines.english: I stormed downstairs and flung open the sliding door.

lines.japanese: 「なんで起こしてくれないんだ」
lines.english: “Why didn't you wake me up?”

lines.japanese: 仕方ないので妹にぶつけた。
lines.english: With no better target available, I vented it at my sister.

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 小鳩はとっくに朝食を終えて、食器を片づけ始めていたところだった。
lines.english: Kobato had finished breakfast long ago and was starting to clear the dishes.

lines.japanese: 「だって目覚まし何度も鳴ってたよ」
lines.english: “But your alarm went off over and over.”

lines.japanese: 「甘ったれるな！」
lines.english: “Don't be so helpless!”

lines.japanese: 「機械文明に支配されて人間の力を侮りやがって。おまえはお兄ちゃんを見捨ててもいいと言うのか」
lines.english: “You let machine civilization rule you, and now you scorn the power of mankind. Are you saying you don't care if your own big brother is abandoned?”

lines.japanese: 「でも今まで起こしにいったことなんてなかったよ」
lines.english: “But you've never had me come wake you before.”

lines.japanese: 「言い訳はいい、どうして起こしてくれなかったのか理由を言いなさい」
lines.english: “Enough excuses. Tell me why you didn't wake me.”

lines.japanese: 「だって起きられなかったのはお兄ちゃんの責任だもん」
lines.english: “Because it's your own fault you couldn't get up.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うるさい、なんて薄情な妹だ。いいよいいよ、じゃあこの寝癖頭で寝巻きのまま外に出て、ご近所に羽田家の家庭内不和を見せつけてやる」
lines.english: “S-shut up! What a heartless little sister. Fine, fine. I'll go outside in my pajamas with my hair like this and parade the Haneda family's domestic discord before the whole neighborhood.”

lines.japanese: 「や、やめてよー。だってさっきから言ってること聞いてても、私ぜんぜん悪くないよ」
lines.english: “D-don't! Everything you've said so far only proves I haven't done anything wrong!”

lines.japanese: 「うるさいうるさい、小鳩さえ起こしてくれれば俺は遅刻しなかったんだ」
lines.english: “Shut up, shut up! If only Kobato had woken me, I wouldn't be late.”

lines.japanese: 「むー。どうせ起こしても起きないくせに」
lines.english: “Hmph. You wouldn't get up even if I tried.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そんなことはない」
lines.english: “Th-that isn't true.”

lines.japanese: 「大体なんだ貴様は、やってもいない内からダメだムリだと泣き言ばかり。諦める前にまずは考えるんだ、どうすればお兄ちゃんが遅刻しないで済むのか、さあ！」
lines.english: “And what is this attitude? Whining that it's hopeless and impossible before you've even tried. Before you give up, think! What can *you* do to keep Big Brother from being late? Well?”

lines.japanese: 「目覚ましいっこ増やしてあげるよ。やったね！」
lines.english: “I'll get you another alarm clock. Yay!”

lines.japanese: 「人任せの愛！」
lines.english: “Love by delegation!”

lines.japanese: 「ああそうか、小鳩はお兄ちゃんのことよりも、朝一分一秒でも早起きして温かいココアを飲みながら一枚でも多くのクッキーを食べることの方が大切なんだね」
lines.english: “Oh, I see. Getting up one second earlier to drink hot cocoa and eat one more cookie matters more to you than your own big brother.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うるさい」
lines.english: “S-shut up.”

lines.japanese: 「いいさ、そんなことは恨んだりしないさ。だけど学校に遅れて先生に怒られたときに俺は必ずこう言うんだ。『うちの妹がカロリーを少しでも多く摂取しようとしたせいで起こしてくれなかったんです』。へへ」
lines.english: “That's fine. I won't hold it against you. But when I arrive late and the teacher scolds me, I will say this: 'My little sister wouldn't wake me because she was busy consuming every possible additional calorie.' Heh heh.”

lines.japanese: 「ううー……わかったよ、明日からちゃんと起こすからわがまま言わないでっ」
lines.english: “Uuugh... Fine! I'll wake you properly from tomorrow on, so stop being selfish!”

lines.japanese: 「はい、はいもう、起こしてもらえるならそれで。ありがとうありがとう」
lines.english: “Yes, yes, that's all I wanted. Thank you, thank you.”

lines.japanese: よかった、これで明日から温かい朝が迎えられそうだ。
lines.english: Excellent. Starting tomorrow, warm mornings awaited me.

lines.japanese: 「あっ、でも小鳩が寝坊しそうになったときはお兄ちゃんが起こしてあげるからな」
lines.english: “Oh, but if *you* ever look likely to oversleep, Big Brother will wake you up.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、そのときはおねがい。それじゃあはい、朝ごはん」
lines.english: “Yes, please. Now—here's breakfast.”

lines.japanese: 「はい？」
lines.english: “Pardon?”

lines.japanese: 目の前に一膳分のごはんとふりかけ、市販製品の海苔の佃煮がとん、とんと順番に並べられた。
lines.english: A serving of rice, some seasoning for it, and store-bought seaweed paste were set down in front of me, one after another.

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃんと話してたら時間がギリギリになっちゃったから、朝ごはんの用意できなかった。今日はこれで食べて。漬物もつけてあげるよ。やったね！」
lines.english: “Talking to you brought me right up to the wire, so I couldn't make breakfast. Eat this today. I'll even throw in pickles. Yay!”

lines.japanese: 「え、えええ、他におかずないの？」
lines.english: “W-wait, there isn't anything else to go with it?”

lines.japanese: だがこれ以上兄に付きあっている余裕はないと判断したのか、小鳩は玄関に向かってしまった。
lines.english: But apparently deciding she couldn't spare her brother another moment, Kobato headed for the front door.

lines.japanese: トゥルルル　トゥルルル
lines.english: Rrrring. Rrrring.

lines.japanese: 「ええい、誰だこんなときにっ」
lines.english: “Who the hell is calling at a time like this?”

lines.japanese: 俺はいらついた手で受話器を持ちあげた。
lines.english: I snatched up the receiver with an irritable hand.

lines.japanese: 「はい俺ハネダ」
lines.english: “Yes, me Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、もしもし羽田さんのお宅ですか？」
lines.english: “Hello? Is this the Haneda residence?”

lines.japanese: 「だから最初に名乗っただろう。この忙しい時間にどなた様だ」
lines.english: “I gave my name the instant I answered. Who is calling at this busy hour?”

lines.japanese: 「す、すみません、あの私、吉川ですけど……」
lines.english: “S-sorry. Um, this is Kikkawa...”

lines.japanese: 「キッカー？　どこのムエタイ小僧だ、痛いと泣きさけぶまでローキックくらわすぞ」
lines.english: “A kicker? What Muay Thai brat are you? I'll low-kick you until you scream for mercy.”

lines.japanese: 「ご、ごめんなさいっ！　あの、もしかしてお兄さんでしょうか」
lines.english: “I-I'm sorry! Um, are you perhaps her brother?”

lines.japanese: 「兄？　確かに俺は兄だが、我が愛しのポッポちゃん以外に兄と呼ばれる筋合いはない。ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Brother? I am indeed a brother, but nobody except my darling Poppo has the right to call me that. I'll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「あの、そのポッポちゃん……？　妹さんはもうお出かけですか？」
lines.english: “Um, that Poppo...? Has your little sister already left?”

lines.japanese: 「アッ！　こ、こここ小鳩の御学友ちゃんでしたか、失礼いたしましたちょっと待ってね？」
lines.english: “Ah! Y-y-you're one of Kobato's esteemed school friends! A thousand pardons. Hold on one moment, please.”

lines.japanese: まずいまずい、ただでさえ友達の少ない小鳩だから、こんなことであの子のポイントが下がっては俺も死んで詫びるしかない。
lines.english: This was bad. Kobato had few enough friends as it was. If this lowered her standing with one of them, I would have no choice but to apologize with my life.

lines.japanese: 俺は玄関で靴を履く小鳩に呼びかけた。
lines.english: I called to Kobato as she put on her shoes in the entryway.

lines.japanese: 「小鳩ー、キッカワさんってひとから電話だぞ」
lines.english: “Kobato! A Miss Kicker's on the phone for you.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、誰？」
lines.english: “What? Who?”

lines.japanese: 「キッカワ。キッカワさん」
lines.english: “Kicker. Miss Kicker.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、知らない。そんなひと聞いたことない」
lines.english: “I don't know her. I've never even heard of anybody like that.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩は急いでいるらしく、俺に困ったような顔を見せた。
lines.english: In her hurry, Kobato gave me a troubled look.

lines.japanese: 「なんだろ、セールスかなあ」
lines.english: “I wonder if it's a sales call.”

lines.japanese: 「なにっ！　朝からうちの小鳩にそんな電話をかけてくるとはふてえ野郎だ、お兄ちゃんが追っぱらってやる」
lines.english: “What!? Some brazen sales creep calling our Kobato first thing in the morning? Big Brother will chase them off.”

lines.japanese: 「わあ、ありがとう。じゃあ私、吉川さんをまたせてるからいってくるね」
lines.english: “Wow, thank you! I'm keeping Yoshikawa waiting, so I'd better go.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、いってらっしゃい。あとはお兄ちゃんに任せておけ。吉川さんによろしくな」
lines.english: “Right, have a good day. Leave the rest to Big Brother. Give my regards to Yoshikawa.”

lines.japanese: 俺は小鳩を笑顔で送りだすと、憤怒の相を浮かべて受話器に向かいあった。
lines.english: I sent Kobato off with a smile, then turned back to the receiver wearing the face of wrath.

lines.japanese: 「おいセールス女ことキッカー」
lines.english: “Listen here, Kicker the saleswoman.”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、もしもし？　あれっ、これまだお兄さん……」
lines.english: “Hello? Oh, is this still her brother...?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえはなんのセールスだと聞いている。壷か。掃除機か。明るい家族計画か」
lines.english: “I asked what you're selling. Pots? Vacuum cleaners? Condoms for a happier home?”

lines.japanese: 「つぼ？」
lines.english: “A pot?”

lines.japanese: 「壺だと？　テメエ、うちの妹にわさび漬けのタコでも作らせるつもりか。頭にかぶせて柔らかくなるまでハイキックをくらわせてやるぞこのタコ壺女！」
lines.english: “A pot, you say? You planning to make my little sister pickle an octopus in wasabi? I'll jam it over your head and high-kick you till you're tender, you octopus-pot woman!”

lines.japanese: <4>\「壺女！　このタコ壺女！」
lines.english: “Pot woman! You octopus-pot woman!”

lines.japanese: <8>\「頭から壺かぶって沈めこのタコ壺女！」
lines.english: “Put the pot over your head and sink, you octopus-pot woman!”

lines.japanese: 俺は妹をペテンにかけようとしたタコ壺女に怒りの雑言をぶつけると、受話器を思い切り叩きつけた。
lines.english: After hurling righteous abuse at the octopus-pot woman who had tried to swindle my sister, I slammed down the receiver.

lines.japanese: もちろん学校には遅刻した。やったね！
lines.english: Naturally, I was late for school. Yay!

lines.japanese: 「おはよう」
lines.english: “Good morning.”

lines.japanese: 「遅かったね」
lines.english: “You’re late.”

lines.japanese: うっすら違和感。山科京が制服を着ている……。
lines.english: Something felt faintly wrong. Miyako Yamashina was wearing her uniform...

lines.japanese: ああいや、これで正しいんだ。そういえば今朝は煙草屋を覗く余裕がなかったけど、彼女はちゃんと学校に来ていたのか。
lines.english: No, wait. This was precisely right. I hadn't had time to look in at Tokitsuru that morning, but apparently she had come to school after all.

lines.japanese: 「おはよう山科さん。今朝は『ときつる』覗いてる暇がなかったよ。いやあ、やっぱり最近はどうにも朝が辛くてな」
lines.english: “Morning, Yamashina. I didn't have time to stop by Tokitsuru today. Mornings have been awfully hard on me lately.”

lines.japanese: 「え、なにか入れ……薬でも飲んだ？」
lines.english: “What, did you put something in...? Take some kind of drug?”

lines.japanese: 不健康トークになると急に目が輝くんだなあ、山科さんは。素晴らしい。さすが、お薬の服用を『入れる』と表現する女は言うことが違う！
lines.english: Her eyes lit up the moment the conversation turned unhealthy. Splendid. As expected, a woman who described taking drugs as 'putting them in' spoke a language all her own!

lines.japanese: 「まあ、俺のは単に、寒くて布団から出たくないってだけだ。で山科さん、一週間ぶりの学校はどうだ」
lines.english: “No, in my case it's simply too cold to get out from under the covers. So, Yamashina—how's school after a week away?”

lines.japanese: 「うんフツー……あ、そうだ。羽田君にお願いしていいかな」
lines.english: “Normal... Oh, right. Haneda, can I ask a favor?”

lines.japanese: 「なんだハンサムか。ほら見ていいぞ、ほらほら」
lines.english: “What, my handsome face? Here, look all you like. Go on, go on.”

lines.japanese: 「先週分のノート見せてもらってもいい？」
lines.english: “Could I borrow your notes from last week?”

lines.japanese: 「ノート？」
lines.english: “My notes?”

lines.japanese: 授業のノートか？　鷹志が丁寧にとってたから、問題はないけど──
lines.english: Class notes? Takashi had taken them carefully, so there shouldn't be a problem—

lines.japanese: 「──でもテストは終わったし、もうすぐ冬休みだ。どうせ残りの授業なんて消化試合だぞ」
lines.english: “But the tests are over, and winter break's nearly here. The remaining classes are just playing out the season.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、だから消化しようかなと思って」
lines.english: “Right. That's why I thought I might as well play them out.”

lines.japanese: 「へえー、山科さんのひとは偉いんだなあ」
lines.english: “Well, well. Aren't you admirable, Yamashina.”

lines.japanese: 「マラソンとか、最後だけ真剣に走るタイプかな」
lines.english: “I suppose I'm the type who only runs seriously at the very end of a marathon.”

lines.japanese: 「という風に、自己分析をしたがるタイプか」
lines.english: “Which makes you the type who enjoys analyzing herself.”

lines.japanese: 「マラソン、学生になってからしたことないけど」
lines.english: “Though I've never run a marathon since becoming a student.”

lines.japanese: 「しかも知ったかぶるタイプか」
lines.english: “And the type who pretends to know what she's talking about.”

lines.japanese: 「ふふっ」
lines.english: “Hee hee.”

lines.japanese: 「おいおい、ひとのハンサムを見て笑うな。失礼なタイプだな」
lines.english: “Hey, don't laugh at a man's handsome face. What an impolite type you are.”

lines.japanese: だが山科京の笑顔は見ていて悪くなかったから、ノートは貸した。
lines.english: Still, Miyako Yamashina's smile was pleasant to watch, so I lent her the notes.

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう、今日授業がある分以外は明日返すね」
lines.english: “Thanks. I'll return everything except the ones I need for today's classes tomorrow.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、いつでもいいぞ」
lines.english: “Sure. Whenever you like.”

lines.japanese: ノートを見ながら山科京が小さく笑っていた。なにがそんなにおかしいんだか。
lines.english: Miyako Yamashina smiled faintly as she looked through the notebooks. What could possibly be so funny?

lines.japanese: やがて担任が来たので俺も席に着いた。ＨＲの途中、山科京が一度だけ振りかえって俺のハンサムを見ていた。
lines.english: Before long our homeroom teacher arrived, and I took my seat. Once during homeroom, Miyako Yamashina turned around to look at my handsome face.

lines.japanese: 「というわけで本日の羽田班は三人も揃った。放課後まで残ってくれた諸君の奮闘を期待して、今日からバキバキのアゲアゲで本格的な活動を始めるぞ。一同シクヨロ！」
lines.english: “And so, today’s Haneda Squad has three whole members. In honor of you brave souls who stayed after school, we’re kicking off serious operations today at full throttle and maximum hype. Let’s do this, gang!”

lines.japanese: 「返事！」
lines.english: “Sound off!”

lines.japanese: 「へーい」
lines.english: “Yaaay.”

lines.japanese: 「はーい」
lines.english: “Yes, sir.”

lines.japanese: 「よし、いい返事だ。じゃあまずは役割分担から始めよう」
lines.english: “Good. Fine answers. First, we'll assign responsibilities.”

lines.japanese: 「まず文章のチェックと並べを――」
lines.english: “To begin with, checking and arranging the written pieces—”

lines.japanese: 「先輩でよくない？」
lines.english: “Why not make Claude do it?”

lines.japanese: 「んー、どっちでも」
lines.english: “Mm. Either way.”

lines.japanese: 「よしじゃあクロードに決定だ。次に寄せ書き集めと写真選びだが――」
lines.english: “Good, Claude it is. Next, collecting messages and selecting photographs—”

lines.japanese: 「先輩でよくない？」
lines.english: “Why not make Claude do it?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、異議はないよ」
lines.english: “Yes, no objections here.”

lines.japanese: 「よしじゃあクロードに決定だ。待てふざけるなおまえら。なんだその適当な態度は。おまえらには率先してクラスのために何かを為そうという気力はないのか」
lines.english: “Good, Claude it is. Wait—stop screwing around! What is this lazy attitude? Have neither of you any drive to step forward and do something for your class?”

lines.japanese: 「それならまず、パネルクイズくんがやってよ」
lines.english: “Then why don't *you* do it first, Mr. Panel Quiz?”

lines.japanese: 「ぱねが付けばいいってもんじゃねえぞ。いやな、俺にはおまえたちを監督するという大事な仕事がある。全体の調和を計り作業を円滑に進める、どうだ俺にしか出来ないだろう」
lines.english: “You can't just stick 'panel' in front of everything! Listen, I have the vital task of supervising you two. Preserving overall harmony, keeping the work moving smoothly—see? A job only I can do.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだ山科、おまえ国語の成績よかっただろう。よっておまえに文集のまとめを命じる」
lines.english: “That's it. Yamashina, your Japanese grades were good. Therefore I command you to compile the anthology.”

lines.japanese: 「成績だったら羽田君の方がいいはずだよ」
lines.english: “Your grades should be better than mine, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ？　そうだっけ？」
lines.english: “Huh? Are they?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。少なくとも夏休み前のテストでは私より羽田君の方が点数は上だったと思う。私の本位ではなかったけど、先生に教えられたから」
lines.english: “Yes. At least on the test before summer break, I think you scored higher than I did. Not that I wanted to know; the teacher told me.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ文集のまとめは、パーマネントくんでいいよね。はい次」
lines.english: “Then Permanent can compile the anthology. Next item.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、待ちなさい、俺抜きで会議を進めるんじゃない！」
lines.english: “W-wait! You cannot conduct this meeting without me!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、懐かしいなあ今年の臨海学校の写真だよ。あはは、渡来さんピースしてる」
lines.english: “Oh, this takes me back. A photo from our seaside school trip. Ha ha, Watarai's flashing a peace sign.”

lines.japanese: 「うあー、やめて。ね、文集の写真に水着とか許して」
lines.english: “Ugh, no. Stop. Please spare me from swimsuit pictures in the anthology.”

lines.japanese: 「そうか、渡来は対外的にいい顔をするのだけは得意だったな。よし、寄せ書き集めは渡来にやらせよう」
lines.english: “True, Watarai was always skilled at putting on a nice face for outsiders. Good. Watarai will collect the messages.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだと。みんなにはいい顔しても、ぱね田にはいい顔しないぞ」
lines.english: “The hell I will. I may play nice for everybody else, but Paneda gets no such treatment.”

lines.japanese: 「そろそろそのぱね田って言い方やめてくんない。ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Will you quit calling me Paneda already? I'll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「なにその人相悪い顔。羽田君はそんな顔しないよね」
lines.english: “What's with that nasty expression? Haneda never makes a face like that.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな顔ってどんな顔だ。見ろこの爽やかな笑顔。俺羽田ガハハハ」
lines.english: “What do you mean, a face like that? Behold this refreshing smile. Me Haneda! Gah ha ha ha!”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ寄せ書き集めは、笑顔の素敵なぱね田くんに決定するとして」
lines.english: “Then message collection goes to Paneda and his lovely smile.”

lines.japanese: 「アレっ！？　それいま君の仕事だって話しあってたよね！？」
lines.english: “What!? Weren't we just discussing how that was *your* job?”

lines.japanese: 「話戻すけど、私の水着を載せるなら山科のも載せるよ。道連れだよね」
lines.english: “Back to the photos: if you use one of me in a swimsuit, you have to use one of Yamashina too. She's coming down with me.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、待って話戻さないで。まだ決定してないよ、してないってばあ」
lines.english: “Wait, don't go back! We haven't decided anything. I'm telling you, we haven't!”

lines.japanese: 「別にいいよ、渡来さんと違って私のことを見るひとは少ないはずだもん。それにどれを使うか決めるのは写真係の羽田君の仕事だよ」
lines.english: “I don't mind. Unlike Watarai, hardly anybody will look at me. Besides, choosing the pictures is your job as photo editor, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「しゃ、写真係じゃないっ！」
lines.english: “I-I am not the photo editor!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、見てみて山科！　これ入学式のクラス写真！　うわー、懐かしいよね」
lines.english: “Oh, look, Yamashina! Our class picture from the entrance ceremony! Wow, that takes me back.”

lines.japanese: 「ふふっ、ホントだ。なんだか卒業が迫ってるのが実感できるね」
lines.english: “Hee hee. It does. It really makes you feel how close graduation is.”

lines.japanese: 「くそ、ひとの話に聞く耳を持とうともしやがらねえ……まったくイカれた雌猫ちゃんたちだ。俺が写真係になったら、女子の水着写真で埋めつくしてやる」
lines.english: “Damn it, they weren't even pretending to listen... What a pair of deranged little kittens. If I become photo editor, I'll fill the thing with swimsuit pictures of every girl in class.”

lines.japanese: 「……うわ、最低」
lines.english: “...Wow. You're disgusting.”

lines.japanese: 「大丈夫、恥を恥だと認識しないことは一つの強さだよ」
lines.english: “It's all right. Failing to recognize shame as shame is one form of strength.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ手伝って」
lines.english: “Then help me.”

lines.japanese: 「わー、見てみて山科、社会科見学で私、めっちゃ半目顔になってるー」
lines.english: “Wow, look, Yamashina! On our social-studies field trip, I got caught with my eyes half closed!”

lines.japanese: 「聞けよ！」
lines.english: “Listen to me!”

lines.japanese: 本日の会議はこれで終了した。
lines.english: Thus concluded today's meeting.

lines.japanese: くそ、あの小娘ども、どうも俺を甘く見てる節があるな。今度からもっと厳しく躾けなければ。
lines.english: Damn those little girls. I had the distinct impression they underestimated me. I would have to discipline them more sternly from now on.

lines.japanese: 渡来はともかく、たった一日で山科がやつに感化されつつある。ハリュー・クロードが渡来の知己である以上、チーム内バランスを保つためにも味方につけておきたい存在だ。
lines.english: Watarai was one thing, but after a single day Yamashina was already falling under her influence. Since Haryu Claude was Watarai's acquaintance, I needed Yamashina on my side to preserve the balance of power within the team.

lines.japanese: くそう、仕方ない。ここは臥薪嘗胆の心で、あした山科にプラモデルでもプレゼントしよう。
lines.english: Damn it. No choice. I would swallow my pride and bide my time, then give Yamashina a model kit tomorrow.

lines.japanese: 決めた。今から買いにいこう。俺は商店街の方に向かうため、いま来た道を引きかえそうとした。
lines.english: Decided. I would buy one now. I started retracing my steps toward the shopping district.

lines.japanese: 「うーん、ちょっと買いすぎちゃったかなあ」
lines.english: “Hmm. Maybe I bought a little too much.”

lines.japanese: あれ？　向こうから歩いてくる二人は……。
lines.english: Huh? Those two coming toward me are...

lines.japanese: 「羽田家ではいっつもそんなに食べるんだ」
lines.english: “Does the Haneda family always eat that much?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、ウチは男のお兄ちゃんだから、いっぱい食べてもらわないと」
lines.english: “Yes. I’ve got a big brother to feed, so I have to make sure he gets plenty.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩と吉川さんだ。またでっかいエコバックを持って……。
lines.english: Kobato and Yoshikawa. And there she was with that enormous reusable bag again...

lines.japanese: ていうか吉川さんに少し持ってもらえ。ネギ出てるネギ。
lines.english: At least let Yoshikawa carry some of it. There were leeks sticking out, Kobato. Leeks.

lines.japanese: 「自分で夕ごはん作ってるんだよね、えらいなー」
lines.english: “You make dinner yourself, right? That's amazing.”

lines.japanese: 「ううんそんなことないよ。大したもの作ってるわけじゃないし」
lines.english: “Oh, it's nothing. I don't make anything elaborate.”

lines.japanese: 「大したものじゃない……」
lines.english: “Nothing elaborate...”

lines.japanese: 吉川さんは歩きながら、ぱんぱんに膨れた小鳩のエコバッグを見つめた。
lines.english: As they walked, Yoshikawa stared at Kobato's bag, swollen nearly to bursting.

lines.japanese: 「ねえ、この赤いのってタコ？」
lines.english: “Hey, is that red thing an octopus?”

lines.japanese: 「これ？　うん、そうだよ。酢の物にしようと思って」
lines.english: “This? Yes. I thought I'd make a vinegar salad with it.”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん……お兄さんってタコが好き？」
lines.english: “Hmm... Does your brother like octopus?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、普通に食べると思うよ」
lines.english: “Yes. I think he’ll eat it.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだあ……私、タコ壺女って言われちゃった」
lines.english: “I see... Somebody called me an octopus-pot woman.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、誰に？　そんな酷いこと言われたの？　お兄ちゃんに言って怒ってもらおうよ」
lines.english: “What? Who said something that awful? Let’s tell my brother and have him give them a piece of his mind.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん？」
lines.english: “Y-yes?”

lines.japanese: 「えへへ、うちのお兄ちゃんは頼りになるよ」
lines.english: “Hee hee. My big brother is very dependable.”

lines.japanese: なんだか過大評価をされていた。
lines.english: I appeared to have been rather overestimated.

lines.japanese: 「羽田さんはホントに羽田兄のことが好きだね」
lines.english: “Haneda, you really love that brother of yours, don’t you?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、大好き！」
lines.english: “Yes. I love him!”

lines.japanese: 「いいなー、私もお兄ちゃんほしかったな」
lines.english: “Lucky. I wish I had a big brother.”

lines.japanese: 「えへへー、いいでしょー。でもウチのお兄ちゃんが一番だと思うよ」
lines.english: “Hee hee, aren't I lucky? But I think my big brother is the best of all.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだと」
lines.english: “The hell you say.”

lines.japanese: 思わず渡来の口癖が伝染ってしまった。ていうか小鳩、外ではあんなあけすけに俺のこと誉めてるのか。
lines.english: Watarai's pet phrase slipped out of me before I could stop it. More to the point, did Kobato praise me this openly when I wasn't around?

lines.japanese: 「えー、そんなに好きなんだ。そうだよね。羽田さん、毎日羽田兄のこと話してるもんね」
lines.english: “Wow, you really do love him. You talk about him every day, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、まだ話したりないんだよ？　お兄ちゃんにはもっといい所あるもん。確かにちょっと暴走しちゃったことはあるけど、今は反省してくれてるし。これからはずっと一緒なんだ」
lines.english: “Mm, but I still haven’t said nearly enough. My brother has so much more going for him. He did go a little out of control once, but he regrets it now. And from now on, we’ll always be together.”

lines.japanese: 「小さい頃はずっと私のこと守ってくれたし、今でも一番頼りにしてるんだ。守ってくれたといえば小さい頃の秋祭りでね……あ、ちょっと話長くなるけどいい？　どこかで座ってく？」
lines.english: “When we were little, he was always protecting me, and even now I rely on him more than anybody. Speaking of him protecting me, there was this autumn festival when we were children... Oh, this might take a while. Is that okay? Should we sit somewhere?”

lines.japanese: 「え、その……あホラ、荷物あるし……」
lines.english: “Well, um... Look, we have all these bags...”

lines.japanese: 「そんなあ、気にしなくていいよぉ」
lines.english: “Oh, you don't have to worry about that.”
“O-okay...”

lines.japanese: 俺は物陰から一部始終を見守っていた。
lines.english: I watched the entire exchange from behind cover.

lines.japanese: な、なんだか照れるを通りこして、なんか小鳩の中で凄いことになってるぞ、俺。
lines.english: Th-this had gone clean past embarrassment. In Kobato's mind, I had apparently become something larger than life.

lines.japanese: まあ今日の夕飯は期待できそうだ。
lines.english: Well, at least dinner looked promising.

lines.japanese: プラモデルを買いに行くのはやめて、まっすぐ家に帰ることにした。
lines.english: I abandoned the model kit and went straight home instead.
